import json, math, os, random, subprocess, sys, tempfile

HERE = "/opt/solo/test4/task087"
SEQ = os.path.join(HERE, "seqmodel.py")

def tiny_gru_model(V=5, H=3, seed=11):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    return {
        "version": 3,
        "vocab": [chr(0x61 + i) for i in range(V)],
        "W": [[rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) for _ in range(V + H)] for _ in range(3 * H)],
        "b": [rng.uniform(-0.1, 0.1) for _ in range(3 * H)],
        "Why": [[rng.uniform(-0.4, 0.4) for _ in range(H)] for _ in range(V)],
        "by": [rng.uniform(-0.1, 0.1) for _ in range(V)],
        "h0": [0.0] * H,
    }

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
mp = os.path.join(tmp, "m.json")
with open(mp, "w") as f:
    json.dump(tiny_gru_model(), f)

def run(cmd):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SEQ, *cmd],
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr

# 1) basic success + determinism
r1 = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "42", "1.0", "0.5",
          "3", "0.8", "12", "4"])
r2 = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "42", "1.0", "0.5",
          "3", "0.8", "12", "4"])
assert r1[:2] == ((0), r1[1]) and r1[2] == b"", r1
assert r1 == r2
assert r1[1].endswith(b"\n") and len(r1[1].decode()) == 13, r1[1]
print("ok success/determinism:", r1[1].decode().strip())

# 2) LENGTH=0 -> LF only
r = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "42", "1.0", "0.5",
        "3", "0.8", "0", "4"])
assert r == (0, b"\n", b""), r
# LENGTH=1
r = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "42", "2.0", "0.5",
        "3", "0.8", "1", "4"])
assert r[0] == 0 and r[2] == b"" and len(r[1].decode()) == 2, r

# 3) K=1 identical to top-k K=1 regardless of TOP_P
for tp in ("0.0001", "0.5", "1"):
    a = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "b", "7", "1.0", "0.2",
             "1", tp, "20", "3"])[1]
    b = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k", mp, "b", "7", "1.0", "0.2",
             "1", "20", "3"])[1]
    assert a == b, (tp, a, b)
print("ok K=1 == top-k K=1")

# 4) TOP_P=1 equivalent to top-k K=3 (prefix = all candidates)
a = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "c", "99", "1.0", "0.7",
         "3", "1.0", "30", "5"])[1]
b = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k", mp, "c", "99", "1.0", "0.7",
         "3", "30", "5"])[1]
assert a == b, (a, b)
print("ok TOP_P=1 == top-k K")

# 5) K=V: compare against independent reference (target uses sK sorted order)
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("seqmodel", SEQ)
sm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sm)

def reference(seed, length, window, start_t, end_t, K, Pp):
    model = tiny_gru_model()
    vocab = model["vocab"]; V = len(vocab)
    cell = sm._gru_cell_loaded(V, len(model["h0"]), model["W"], model["b"])
    Why, by, h0 = model["Why"], model["by"], model["h0"]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    memory = [h0]; h = list(h0); x = vocab.index("a"); out = []
    for t in range(length):
        T = start_t if length == 1 else start_t + (end_t - start_t) * t / (length - 1)
        xv = [0.0]*V; xv[x] = 1.0
        h, _ = cell.forward(xv, h)
        M = sm._window_tail(memory, str(window))
        u = sm._attn_context(h, M)
        z = sm._output_logits(Why, by, u)
        aa = [zk/T for zk in z]; mm = max(aa)
        e = [math.exp(q-mm) for q in aa]
        order = sorted(range(V), key=lambda k: (-e[k], k))
        cands = order[:K]
        sK = math.fsum  # no: must match plain addition
        sK = 0.0
        for i in cands: sK += e[i]
        target = Pp * sK
        pref = []; s = 0.0
        for i in cands:
            pref.append(i); s += e[i]
            if s >= target: break
        u_rand = rng.random() * s
        chosen = pref[-1]; cum = 0.0
        for i in pref:
            cum += e[i]
            if cum > u_rand: chosen = i; break
        out.append(vocab[chosen]); x = chosen
        memory.append([float(v) for v in h])
    return "".join(out)

for Pp in (0.3, 0.5, 0.9):
    for K in (2, 3, 5):
        ref = reference(123, 40, 4, 1.1, 0.6, K, Pp)
        got = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "123",
                   "1.1", "0.6", str(K), repr(Pp), "40", "4"])[1].decode().strip()
        assert ref == got, (K, Pp, ref, got)
print("ok matches independent reference")

# 6) error protocol: bad TOP_P, K>V, lex, missing model, START not in vocab
bad = [
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "3", "0", "5", "4"],   # p=0
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "3", "1.1", "5", "4"], # p>1
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "3", "nan", "5", "4"],
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "3", "inf", "5", "4"],
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "0", "0.5", "5", "4"], # K=0 lex
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "6", "0.5", "5", "4"], # K>V
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "03", "0.5", "5", "4"],
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "01", "1", "1", "3", "0.5", "5", "4"],
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "z", "0", "1", "1", "3", "0.5", "5", "4"],
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1", "3", "0.5", "5", "0"], # window 0
    ["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "-1", "3", "0.5", "5", "4"],
]
for args in bad:
    rc, out, err = run(args)
    assert (rc, out, err) == (2, b"", b"error\n"), (args, rc, out, err)
# missing model
rc, out, err = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", os.path.join(tmp, "nope"),
                    "a", "0", "1", "1", "3", "0.5", "5", "4"])
assert (rc, out, err) == (2, b"", b"error\n"), (rc, out, err)
# wrong argc (10 args like top-k command)
rc, out, err = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1",
                    "3", "0.5", "5"])
assert rc == 2 and out == b"" and err == b"error\n", (rc, out, err)
# huge K text: digit/lex comparison only, no int() exception
rc, out, err = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "0", "1", "1",
                    "9"*5000, "0.5", "5", "4"])
assert (rc, out, err) == (2, b"", b"error\n"), (rc, out[:10], err)
print("ok error protocol")

# 7) TOP_P tiny still >= first candidate (shortest prefix len 1)
r = run(["sample-gru-attn-top-k-top-p", mp, "a", "5", "1", "1",
         "3", "5e-324", "10", "4"])
assert r[0] == 0, r
print("ok tiny top_p")
print("ALL PASS")
EOF
